As a Logistics Production Operator, you ensure that the inbound and outbound flow of materials within the recycling process runs smoothly. You have a varied role: at times you operate a forklift to move raw materials or finished products, while at other times you support the production process and make sure the machines keep running. In this way, you play a key role in the reuse of PET bottles and other plastics, contributing every day to a more sustainable world.

Your Responsibilities

- Loading, unloading, and moving materials and finished products using a forklift
- Supplying raw materials to machines and replacing filters
- Monitoring inventory and maintaining an orderly warehouse and site
- Ensuring a safe, clean, and well-organized working environment
- Liaising with the Technical Department in case of malfunctions or technical issues

What We Ask

- A practical and flexible work attitude
- Experience in production or logistics is a plus
- Forklift certificate or willingness to obtain one
- A team player with a strong focus on safety and quality

You will work in a fixed 10-day shift rotation:

- 2 days early shift (06:00 – 14:00)
- 2 days late shift (14:00 – 22:00)
- 2 days night shift (22:00 – 06:00)

After this, you have 4 days off before the cycle starts again.

- Forklift certificate or driving license (no certificate yet? You can obtain one through us)
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Hands-on mentality with a strong focus on results

jobs.description:
About Grupo Pampling

We are a textile company founded in Seville over 20 years ago, with a presence across Spain, Europe, and Latin America through more than 100 company-owned stores and a strong online channel that connects us with customers worldwide. Our philosophy is based on offering original and sustainable fashion, fostering creativity, diverse talent, and responsible production.

Our portfolio includes brands with their own unique identity: Pampling, Wituka, Pájaro Flama, Nerry, Nostalgic Apparel, Agobio, Catharsis, BM Collective, Citees, Pampling&Co, among others. We also have our own screen-printing workshop, Print Guru (El Pulpo), which allows us to oversee every stage of production and ensure outstanding quality. In addition, we manage our logistics and distribution in-house, optimizing processes and providing an agile response across all our sales channels.

Who are we?

We are a diverse and dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and the drive to take on new challenges. We are looking for people with initiative, commitment, and a passion for design, fashion, and innovation. Our goal is to continue growing alongside a dedicated team while maintaining our focus on delivering high-quality products, competitive prices, and excellent customer service.

What are we looking for?

We are looking to hire Sales Assistants for our new Pampling&Co store located in Amsterdam city centre.

These are part-time positions of 20 and 30 hours with rotating morning and afternoon shifts, with an expected start date of September the 25th.

Previous customer service experience and a good level of English is required.

Main Responsibilities

- Advise and assist customers throughout their shopping experience.

- Answer customer inquiries, resolve issues, and process payments at the checkout.

- Support inventory management, stock control, orders, and warehouse operations.

- Maintain store visual standards in line with the brand's identity and values.
